title: Valorization of apricot and peach pomaces as sustainable ingredients for the formulation of carotenoid-enriched puddings
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,1821-1829
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00518C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Aslı Yıldırım Vardin, Dilara Konuk Takma
Techno-functional properties of puddings enriched with apricot and peach pomaces were presented. The valorization of fruit pomace as a functional ingredient improved the nutritional quality of the puddings and promoted circular bioeconomy practices.
